article.headline: Bubu Benjamin scores 21 to lead Tarleton State over UT Arlington 77-74
article.description: — Bubu Benjamin scored 21 points to lead Tarleton State over UT Arlington 77-74 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Bubu Benjamin scores 21 to lead Tarleton State over UT Arlington 77-74
article.story: STEPHENVILLE, Texas -- — Bubu Benjamin scored 21 points to lead Tarleton State over UT Arlington 77-74 on Saturday night. Benjamin went 8 of 16 from the field (3 for 6 from 3-point range) for the Texans (6-10, 1-0 Western Athletic Conference). Dantwan Grimes totaled 18 points and three steals. Grimes made two free throws with 3 seconds left to help Tarleton hold on. Chris Mpaka scored 10. The Mavericks (7-8, 0-1) were led by Brody Robinson with 21 points. Jaden Wells added 15 points and Raysean Seamster contributed 10 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
